name: Gwaii Haanas National Park Reserve, National Marine Conservation Area Reserve, and Haida Heritage Site
story: Gwaii Haanas National Park Reserve, National Marine Conservation Area Reserve, and Haida Heritage Site is located in southernmost Haida Gwaii, 130 kilometres off the mainland of British Columbia, Canada. It protects an archipelago of 138 islands, with close to 90% of the land being forested. The area ranges from deep fjords to rugged mountains and is cooperatively managed by the Council of the Haida Nation and the Government of Canada.
matters: Gwaii Haanas National Marine Conservation Area Reserve covers 3,400 square kilometres and is a primary feeding habitat of the North Pacific humpback whale protected by Canada's Species at Risk Act. Nearly 5,000 square kilometres of Gwaii Haanas are protected, making it one of the only places in the world protected from mountain top to ocean depth.
